reason_not_in.cursor: It watches Claude Code's tool names for the Slack server.

does: Experimental. Lets a chat read Slack but never post, react, join or mark anything other people see.

children.does: A pattern for the full tool names of your Slack server, such as mcp__slack__.*.
Only the read tools of the tested server version pass. Every other tool is refused, and so are unknown tools and broken input.
